relationship: Oracle identifies its Abilene facility as powered by the ERCOT grid.
relationshipZh: Oracle 指出其阿比林設施由 ERCOT 電網供電。
sourceTitle: Oracle Invests in More Than 1.7 GW of Carbon-Free Electricity to Support AI Growth and Strengthen the Texas Grid

relationship: Apollo is an optioned site up to 900 MW near San Antonio, explicitly submitted to ERCOT Batch Zero; this is a studied-load development relationship, not operating or energized capacity.
relationshipZh: Apollo 是 San Antonio 附近最高 900 MW 的選擇權場址，明確申請 ERCOT Batch Zero 研究負載；屬開發階段連結，並非已營運或通電容量。
sourceTitle: Cipher Digital Provides Second Quarter 2026 Business Update

relationship: Constellation announced a 20-year agreement to match Microsoft data-center electricity consumption in PJM with output from a planned Crane restart. This is a power supply relationship, not a named Microsoft facility or an operating restart.
relationshipZh: Constellation 公布 20 年協議，以規劃重啟的 Crane 電廠發電匹配 Microsoft 在 PJM 的資料中心用電。此為供電關係，未指名 Microsoft 設施，也不代表電廠已重啟營運。
sourceTitle: Constellation to Launch Crane Clean Energy Center, Restoring Jobs and Carbon-Free Power to The Grid
